nodes.name: Set Scrape Params
nodes.notes: Edit niche/location per run. callback_url is computed here (same pattern as your psychology-pipeline render_id workflow) — Wait node below resumes on this exact URL.

nodes.name: Trigger GitHub Action
nodes.notes: Reuses your existing 'Github Global' Header Auth credential — same one your other repos' dispatch calls use. Needs actions:write + contents:read on Map-sdingo.

nodes.name: Wait For Scrape Result
nodes.notes: Resumes when the GitHub Action POSTs its results to $execution.resumeUrl. 85 min ceiling — the Action's job timeout is 75 min (raised again since -extra-reviews' DOM-scroll fallback and -email crawling both add real time per business), so this gives it room to finish and still land here.

nodes.name: Append Lead
nodes.notes: Value Input Mode set to RAW so nothing (phone numbers starting with '+', the long numeric cid) gets misread as a formula or auto-converted to a number. USER_ENTERED (n8n's default) tries to interpret values the way a human typing them would, which is exactly what breaks '+27...' phone numbers into #ERROR!.

nodes.name: Seen Leads Webhook
nodes.notes: This URL is what you set as the N8N_SEEN_LOOKUP_URL secret in the GitHub repo. Called with ?niche=...&location=...

nodes.name: Read All Leads
nodes.notes: Same Sheet ID as the 'Receive Leads Into Sheet' workflow. Reads the whole sheet — fine at this scale, revisit if the sheet grows into the tens of thousands of rows.

nodes.name: Has Email?
nodes.notes: True (output 0) = has email, skip WhatsApp drafting entirely. False (output 1) = no email, draft a WhatsApp message instead. Only ever one or the other, never both, per your instruction.

nodes.name: No Draft Needed
nodes.notes: Has an email already — leave these three columns blank rather than draft a WhatsApp message, per your instruction: email leads get put aside, not double-worked.

nodes.name: Draft WhatsApp Message (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Credential: HTTP Header Auth, header name 'x-goog-api-key', value = your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio (free tier). Model name assumes gemini-2.0-flash — change to whatever model your other Gemini pipelines already use if different.

nodes.name: Merge Branches
nodes.notes: Recombines the 'has email, no draft' rows and the 'no email, drafted' rows into one list before writing to the Sheet. Merge node's UI has changed across n8n versions — if 'append' mode isn't what you see, pick whichever option just concatenates both inputs into one list (not a field-matching join).
